arxiv-1804-03603.title: Third Party Tracking in the Mobile Ecosystem Conference: 10th ACM Conference on Web Science; May 27–30, 2018; Amsterdam, Netherlands WebSci ’18: 10th ACM Conference on Web Science, May 27–30, 2018, Amsterdam, Netherlands Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3201064.3201089 ISBN: 978-1-4503-5563-6/18/05 CCS: Se
arxiv-1804-03603.creator: Reuben Binns, Ulrik Lyngs, Max Van Kleek, Jun Zhao, Timothy Libert , Nigel Shadbolt
arxiv-1804-03603.description: Abstract . Third party tracking allows companies to identify users and track their behaviour across multiple digital services. This paper presents an empirical study of the prevalence of third-party trackers on 959,000 apps from the US and UK Google Play stores.

arxiv-1902-05004.title: Cancer recurrence times from a branching process model
arxiv-1902-05004.creator: Stefano Avanzini and Tibor Antal
arxiv-1902-05004.description: Abstract As cancer advances, cells often spread from the primary tumor to other parts of the body and form metastases. This is the main cause of cancer related mortality. Here we investigate a conceptually simple model of metastasis formation where metastatic lesions are initiated at a rate which depends on the size of the primary tumor.

arxiv-2008-08711.title: The WaZP galaxy cluster sample of the Dark Energy Survey Year 1 2021 The WaZP galaxy cluster sample of the Dark Energy Survey Year 1 – Affiliations
arxiv-2008-08711.creator: M. Aguena, C. Benoist, L. N. da Costa, R. L. C. Ogando, J. Gschwend, H. B. Sampaio-Santos, M. Lima, M. A. G. Maia, S. Allam, S. Avila, D. Bacon, E. Bertin, S. Bhargava, D. Brooks, A. Carnero Rosell, M. Carrasco Kind, J. Carretero, M. Costanzi, J. De Vicente, S. Desai, H. T. Diehl, P. Doel, S. Everet
arxiv-2008-08711.description: Abstract We present a new (2+1)D galaxy cluster finder based on photometric redshifts called Wavelet Z Photometric ( W a ZP ) applied to DES first year (Y1A1) data. The results are compared to clusters detected by the South Pole Telescope (SPT) survey and the redMaPPer cluster finder, the latter based on the same photometric data.

arxiv-2104-10236.title: A Game Theoretic Approach to a Problem in Polymatroid Maximization
arxiv-2104-10236.creator: Lisa Hellerstein, Thomas Lidbetter
arxiv-2104-10236.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lisa Hellerstein, Thomas Lidbetter. We consider the problem of maximizing the minimum (weighted) value of all components of a vector over a polymatroid. This is a special case of the lexicographically optimal base problem introduced and solved by Fujishige. We give an alternative formulation of the problem as a zero-sum game between a maximizing player whose mixed strategy set is the base of the polymatroid and a minimizing player whose mixed strategy set is a simplex.

arxiv-2108-02491.title: Quantum Charging Advantage Cannot Be Extensive Without Global Operations
arxiv-2108-02491.creator: Ju-Yeon Gyhm, Dominik Šafránek, Dario Rosa
arxiv-2108-02491.description: Abstract Quantum batteries are devices made from quantum states, which store and release energy in a fast and efficient manner, thus offering numerous possibilities in future technological applications. They offer a significant charging speedup when compared to classical batteries, due to the possibility of using entangling charging operations.

arxiv-2212-13392.title: DeepCuts: Single-Shot Interpretability based Pruning for BERT
arxiv-2212-13392.creator: Jasdeep Singh Grover*, Bhavesh Gawri*, Ruskin Raj Manku*
arxiv-2212-13392.description: Abstract As language models have grown in parameters and layers, it has become much harder to train and infer with them on single GPUs. This is severely restricting the availability of large language models such as GPT-3, BERT-Large, and many others.

arxiv-2305-06333.title: Direct-Laser-Written Polymer Nanowire Waveguides for Broadband Single Photon Collection from Epitaxial Quantum Dots into a Gaussian-like Mode
arxiv-2305-06333.creator: Edgar F. Perez, Cori Haws, Marcelo Davanco, Jindong Song, Luca Sapienza, Kartik Srinivasan
arxiv-2305-06333.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Edgar F. Perez, Cori Haws, Marcelo Davanco, Jindong Song, Luca Sapienza, Kartik Srinivasan. Single epitaxial quantum dots (QDs) embedded in nanophotonic geometries are a leading technology for quantum light generation. However, efficiently coupling their emission into a single mode fiber or Gaussian beam often remains challenging. Here, we use direct laser writing (DLW) to address this challenge by fabricating 1 μ \mu m diameter polymer nanowires (PNWs) in-contact-with and perpendicular-to a QD-containing GaAs layer.

arxiv-2305-07785.title: Unveiling the formation of the massive DR21 ridge Facilities: SOFIA (upGREAT), IRAM 30m, Herschel, JCMT astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 )
arxiv-2305-07785.creator: L. Bonne, S. Bontemps, N. Schneider, R. Simon, S. D. Clarke, T. Csengeri, E. Chambers, U. Graf, J. M. Jackson, R. Klein, Y. Okada, A. G. G. M. Tielens, M. Tiwari
arxiv-2305-07785.description: Abstract We present new 13 CO(1-0), C 18 O(1-0), HCO + (1-0) and H 13 CO + (1-0) maps from the IRAM 30m telescope, and a spectrally-resolved [C II ] 158 μ \mu m map observed with the SOFIA telescope towards the massive DR21 cloud.

arxiv-2410-22709.title: FilterMobileViT and DropoutVIT
arxiv-2410-22709.creator: 1 st Bohang Sun, 2 st Bo Chen
arxiv-2410-22709.description: Abstract In this study, we propose an improved variant of ViT that performs attention-based QKV operations in the early stages of downsampling. Directly conducting attention operations on high-resolution feature maps is computationally intensive due to the large size and numerous tokens.

arxiv-2411-05365.title: Reconstruction of a function defined on a sphere using the Funk transform Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2411-05365.creator: Rafik Aramyan, Institute of Mathematics of NAS RA, Yerevan, Armenia
arxiv-2411-05365.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rafik Aramyan, Institute of Mathematics of NAS RA, Yerevan, Armenia. It is known that the Funk transform (the Funk-Radon transform) is invertible in the class of even (symmetric) continuous functions defined on the unit 2-sphere 𝐒 2 \mathbf{S}^{2} . In this article, for the reconstruction of f ∈ C ⁡ ( 𝐒 2 ) f\in C(\mathbf{S}^{2}) (can be non-even), an additional condition (to reconstruct an odd function) is found, and the injectivity of the so-called two data Funk transform is considered.

arxiv-2511-20538.title: A Presymplectic and Symmetry-Reduced Formulation of the Maxwell–Vlasov System
arxiv-2511-20538.creator: Leonardo J. Colombo
arxiv-2511-20538.description: Abstract We develop a unified geometric formulation of the Maxwell–Vlasov system using the infinite-dimensional Skinner–Rusk (SR) formalism. In this framework, particles and fields are treated simultaneously within a single presymplectic manifold, and the Gotay–Nester–Hinds algorithm recovers the full Maxwell–Vlasov equations as the compatibility conditions of a single variational system.

pmc-10506332.title: Arginase-1 promotes lens epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition in different models of anterior subcapsular cataract
pmc-10506332.creator: Qingyu Li, Yuchuan Wang, Luoluo Shi, Qing Wang, Guang Yang, Lin Deng, Ye Tian, Xia Hua, Xiaoyong Yuan
pmc-10506332.description: BackgroundArginase-1 (ARG1) promotes collagen synthesis and cell proliferation. ARG1 is highly expressed in various tumour cells. The mechanisms of ARG1 in epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-associated cataracts were studied herein.MethodsC57BL/6 mice, a human lens epithelial cell line (HLEC-SRA01/04), and human lens capsule samples were used in this study.

pmc-11312420.title: Wnt5a Promotes Axon Elongation in Coordination with the Wnt–Planar Cell Polarity Pathway
pmc-11312420.creator: Samar Ahmad, Liliana Attisano, Jessica Filosa
pmc-11312420.description: The establishment of neuronal polarity, involving axon specification and outgrowth, is critical to achieve the proper morphology of neurons, which is important for neuronal connectivity and cognitive functions. Extracellular factors, such as Wnts, modulate diverse aspects of neuronal morphology. In particular, non-canonical Wnt5a exhibits differential effects on neurite outgrowth depending upon the context.

pmc-11476247.title: Incidental diagnosis of gastric antral vascular ectasia in a case of chronic kidney disease from Nepal: a case report
pmc-11476247.creator: Ashish Acharya, Kritika Bhattarai, Abashesh Bhandari
pmc-11476247.description: IntroductionGastric antral vascular ectasia is an uncommon clinical disease that affects elder people and is characterized by severe chronic upper gastrointestinal bleeding mainly affecting the gastric antrum. It is generally unusual among patients undergoing maintenance hemodialysis for chronic kidney disease.

pmc-12630136.title: Molecular basis of tRNA aminocarboxypropyl-transferase TapT for substrate recognition
pmc-12630136.creator: Wei-Yan Wang, Heng-Rui Liang, Yu-Cong Wu, Ping-Wei Liu, Zhu Wang, Yi-Yang Jiang, Hai-Xue Pan, Gong-Li Tang, Jin-Yue Pu, Ai-Ai Sun
pmc-12630136.description: 3-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl) uridine (acp3U) is a highly conserved modification found in variable- and D-loops of transfer RNAs (tRNAs) in bacteria and eukarya. TapT has been identified as the enzyme responsible for acp3U modification at position 47 of Escherichia coli tRNAs in the presence of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM), while the specific substrate binding details and catalytic mechanism of TapT remain unknown.
